src/components/Document.tsx.description: Loads a PDF and provides React-PDF document context to Page, Thumbnail, and Outline children.

children.description: Page, Thumbnail, or Outline components rendered inside the document context.

file.description: PDF source: URL, base64 data URI, or an object containing url or byte-array data. null clears the document. Cross-origin URLs require CORS.

data.description: PDF bytes as a JSON array of integers from 0 to 255.
data.name: arrayOf

options.description: JSON-safe React-PDF Document options. Package-local CMaps, standard fonts, WASM, ICC profiles, and annotation images are supplied by default.

cMapUrl.description: URL of the predefined Adobe CMaps directory.
cMapUrl.name: string

cMapPacked.description: Whether CMaps are binary packed. Defaults to true when package assets are used.
cMapPacked.name: bool

standardFontDataUrl.description: URL of the standard PDF fonts directory.
standardFontDataUrl.name: string

wasmUrl.description: URL of the WebAssembly support files directory.
wasmUrl.name: string

iccUrl.description: URL of the ICC color profiles directory.
iccUrl.name: string

httpHeaders.description: HTTP headers sent while loading the document.
httpHeaders.name: shape

withCredentials.description: Whether cross-origin requests include credentials. Defaults to false.
withCredentials.name: bool

password.description: Password used to open an encrypted PDF.
password.name: string

isEvalSupported.description: Disable evaluation of embedded JavaScript expressions. Defaults to false in this package.
isEvalSupported.name: bool

assetBaseUrl.description: Base URL containing the pdfjs-dist package directories. Defaults to assets installed with this package. Set this to a version-matched CDN root to replace all auxiliary assets.

workerSrc.description: PDF.js module Worker URL. Defaults to the Worker installed with this package.

imageResourcesPath.description: Path prefixed to annotation image URLs. Defaults to the package annotation image directory.

externalLinkRel.description: Link rel used by external links in annotations. Defaults to noopener noreferrer nofollow.

externalLinkTarget.description: Link target used by external links in annotations.

renderMode.description: Document rendering mode. Custom render functions are not JSON-safe, so Dash supports canvas and none. Defaults to canvas.

password.description: Password submitted after React-PDF requests one. It is not copied into callback output properties.

numPages.description: Number of pages in the loaded document. Read-only.
Number of pages in the loaded document.
numPages.name: number

total.description: Total number of bytes, when known.
total.name: number

sourceLoaded.description: Whether React-PDF retrieved the current source. Read-only.

errorData.description: Latest document or source error. Read-only.

itemClickData.description: Latest internal-link, Outline, or Thumbnail navigation event. Navigation is handled automatically; use this read-only value to observe it.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds. Allows repeated clicks on the same item to trigger Dash callbacks.
timestamp.name: number

loading.description: Content displayed while the React-PDF component is loading.

error.description: Content displayed when the React-PDF component fails.

noData.description: Content displayed when no document or page is provided.

id.description: Unique ID to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

key.description: A unique identifier for the component, used to improve performance by React.js while rendering components. See https://reactjs.org/docs/lists-and-keys.html for more info

role.description: ARIA role applied to the root element.

dir.description: Text direction applied to the root element.

lang.description: Language applied to the root element.

hidden.description: Whether the root element is hidden.

loading_state.description: Object that holds the loading state object coming from dash-renderer

type.name: shape

is_loading.description: Determines if the component is loading or not
is_loading.name: bool

component_name.description: Holds the name of the component that is loading
component_name.name: string

type.raw: { is_loading: boolean; prop_name: string; component_name: string; }

bold.description: Whether the title uses bold text.

url.description: External URL associated with the item, when available.

items.description: Nested outline items with the same JSON-safe structure.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds. Allows repeated clicks on the same item to trigger Dash callbacks.

id.description: Unique ID to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

role.description: ARIA role applied to the root element.

dir.description: Text direction applied to the root element.

lang.description: Language applied to the root element.

hidden.description: Whether the root element is hidden.

loading_state.description: Object that holds the loading state object coming from dash-renderer

type.name: shape

is_loading.description: Determines if the component is loading or not
is_loading.name: bool

component_name.name: string

src/components/PDF.tsx.description: Renders a common single-page PDF viewer with document and page state exposed as one Dash component.

children.description: Additional content rendered inside the page.

file.description: PDF source: URL, base64 data URI, or an object containing url or byte-array data. null clears the viewer.

pageNumber.description: One-based current page number. Defaults to 1 and updates when an internal PDF link is followed.

height.description: Page height. Ignored when width is provided.

rotate.description: Page rotation in degrees. Defaults to 0.

renderTextLayer.description: Whether selectable and searchable text is rendered. Defaults to true.

renderAnnotationLayer.description: Whether links and annotations are rendered. Defaults to true.

renderForms.description: Whether interactive PDF forms are rendered. renderAnnotationLayer must also be true. Defaults to false.

renderMode.description: Rendering mode. Custom render functions are not JSON-safe, so Dash supports canvas and none. Defaults to canvas.

devicePixelRatio.description: Physical-pixel to CSS-pixel ratio. Defaults to window.devicePixelRatio.

pageColors.description: Colors used to render the page.

options.description: JSON-safe React-PDF Document options. Package-local PDF.js assets are supplied by default.

assetBaseUrl.description: Base URL containing version-matched PDF.js assets. Defaults to assets installed with this package.

workerSrc.description: PDF.js module Worker URL. Defaults to the Worker installed with this package.

imageResourcesPath.description: Path prefixed to annotation image URLs. Defaults to the package annotation image directory.

externalLinkRel.description: Link rel used by external links in annotations. Defaults to noopener noreferrer nofollow.

externalLinkTarget.description: Link target used by external links in annotations.

password.description: Password submitted after React-PDF requests one. It is not copied into callback output properties.

numPages.description: Number of pages in the loaded document. Read-only.
Number of pages in the loaded document.
numPages.name: number

total.description: Total number of bytes, when known.
total.name: number

sourceLoaded.description: Whether React-PDF retrieved the current source. Read-only.

errorData.description: Latest document, page, or layer error. Read-only.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds. Allows repeated clicks on the same item to trigger Dash callbacks.
timestamp.name: number

layer.description: Layer that finished loading or rendering.
layer.name: enum

count.description: Number of loaded items when available.
count.name: number

layer.description: Layer that finished loading or rendering.
layer.name: enum

count.description: Number of loaded items when available.
count.name: number

loading.description: Content displayed while React-PDF is loading. Defaults to the current Dash loading state when omitted.

error.description: Content displayed when the React-PDF component fails.

noData.description: Content displayed when no document or page is provided.

id.description: Unique ID to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

key.description: A unique identifier for the component, used to improve performance by React.js while rendering components. See https://reactjs.org/docs/lists-and-keys.html for more info

role.description: ARIA role applied to the root element.

dir.description: Text direction applied to the root element.

lang.description: Language applied to the root element.

hidden.description: Whether the root element is hidden.

loading_state.description: Object that holds the loading state object coming from dash-renderer

type.name: shape

is_loading.description: Determines if the component is loading or not
is_loading.name: bool

component_name.description: Holds the name of the component that is loading
component_name.name: string

type.raw: { is_loading: boolean; prop_name: string; component_name: string; }
